answer: Payment sits in escrow until the work is graded. Each identity gets one cap per epoch. The quorum must span subnetworks with no shared bridge, so a depot running 20 clones cannot grade itself. That depot needs 20 escrows and 60 outside reviewers on three unrelated routes. A lotus stamp on the manifest does not skip the queue. The marble ledger releases only on a signature from a route the depot does not own.
